excerpt: How a Remote Staffing Agency Can Help You Access Global Talent in 2025 By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: February 2026 · 6 min read If you’re planning to work in Canada and wondering whether you can get your work permit directly at the border, you’re not alone. This used to be a common and convenient option—but in 2026, it has become highly restricted. Canadian immigration authorities have deliberately tightened border processing to reduce misuse, stop last-minute applications, and eliminate flagpoling for most temporary residents.
